name: RMIT Welcome and Sam and Nina Narodowski Asylum Seeker Scholarship
summary: A full tuition fee waiver plus SSAF for continuing RMIT students seeking asylum who are in financial hardship.
key: Full program tuition fees and SSAF. 18 awarded in 2026.
who: Continuing student enrolled or intending to enrol full-time.
Able to demonstrate financial hardship and living in Australia.
how: Complete the online application by the close date.

evidence.quote: The scholarships consist of full program tuition fees and Student Services and Amenities Fees (SSAF) paid per semester
Applications for Semester 1 2027 close 11:59pm Wednesday 9 December 2026. No late applications will be accepted.
